name: code-readout
title: Code Readout
description: A short code read out to be typed elsewhere (a sign-in's one-time code, a device's pairing code): 32px on 40px lines (the theme's text-readout), monospaced, its characters in groups (`group`, 4 by default) apart by a margin, not spaces, so it is copied and selected whole; read out character by character to a screen reader, its `label` first. Beside it, a CopyButton with `showLabel`.
